text:
Samira (CEO): Quick weekly — high level and a few asks. Great work on the cache rollback Friday; we avoided a larger regression. TL;DR: Private GA next week, a small hosted policy tweak, and keep reliability the north star.

Samira (CEO): Launch: Private GA scheduled Tue 04:00 UTC. Carlos leading rollout. We will canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback on error-rate > 1.2%. Please treat the canary window as sacrosanct.

Samira (CEO): Policy: hosted default data retention will move from 180d -> 90d for new workspaces starting next Monday. This reduces storage and helps compliance posture. Ops + Comms — prepare messaging and migration guidance.

Samira (CEO): Metrics snapshot: p50 generation latency ~62ms, p95 ~210ms (week avg). Uptime last 7d: 99.96%. Token cost improvements from Optimize are tracking -4% week-over-week; target -6% by EOW.

Jordan (VP Eng): ack. will freeze infra changes during canary window. autoscaler bump for dedicated pools is queued.

Priya (VP Product): docs + changelog team on it. we'll add an FAQ for retention changes and a one-click migration for orgs that want 180d preserved.

Carlos (Head of Ops): Rollout plan (short):
- Tue 04:00 UTC start canary (5%)
- Tue 16:00 -> 25% if metrics ok
- Wed 04:00 -> 100%
- Rollback: immediate on error-rate > 1.2% or latency > 2x baseline

Carlos (Head of Ops): pinging eng-oncall for the canary window. We'll stream health metrics to the #release-war-room channel.

Marta (SRE): Incident recap (cache regression): root cause was a KV eviction bug triggered by a new prefix-caching heuristic. Fix: pin TTLs for hot prefixes and revert heuristic. Postmortem draft in /docs/incidents/cache-regression-2026.md. Action items:
- Add a safelist for known hot prefixes (owner: eng-runtime)
- Add a regression test for prefix eviction at scale (owner: eng-ml)
- Improve alerting: add an SLI on cache-miss spike (owner: eng-sre)

Eli (Comms): Draft internal + customer note ready. Link: https://redwood.co/comm-drafts/private-ga-retention (please review). Will hold external send until product sign-off.

Samira (CEO): One explicit ask: engineering, please run the canary with reduced quantization aggressiveness for the first 25%—we want functional parity first, perf later. Product/comms: emphasize that this is a careful rollout to protect customer latency and deterministic outputs.

Jordan (VP Eng): understood. setting canary kernel profile to "conservative" for first two waves. config snippet:
```
canary_profile: conservative
max_batch_tokens: 2048
quantization: 8bit-safe
```

Carlos (Head of Ops): DeployBot scheduled the canary deploy for Tue 04:00 UTC — Deploy ID: deploy-2793456789-privga.

DeployBot: Scheduled deployment deploy-2793456789-privga -> start: 2026-04-07T04:00:00Z. Notifying watchers: Samira, Jordan, Carlos, Marta.

Priya (VP Product): small ask from sales: include a slide about routing/fallback guarantees for Private GA in the partner deck. I'll sync with Solutions.

Marta (SRE): will add the cache-miss SLI to the dashboard and set an automated pager if 5m spike > 3x baseline.

Samira (CEO): Finally — thank you. Two-week focus: 1) safe Private GA, 2) retention policy rollout with clear migration path, 3) hit that -6% unit cost target. I'll run a short follow-up on Friday with a quick scoreboard. :thumbsup:

Jordan (VP Eng): :thumbsup:

Carlos (Head of Ops): 👍 will post canary playbook in #release-war-room 2h before start.

Eli (Comms): will queue the external announcement for Thurs pending product sign-off.

Samira (CEO): If anyone sees blockers for the canary or messaging, flag now. Otherwise, let's execute.
